steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Pizza delivery from 'One More Slice'!

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Pumpkin Pepper, Cheese, Fries & Sausage, Supreme, Devil's Pepper, and classic Mozzarella.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Eat up! Can't work on an empty stomach. This one's yours, Signor Emperor... er, should I call you Consultant instead?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Mm. Not bad. Soft and chewy crust, nice meaty flavor. You got a card for this pizzeria?

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: I made it myself at the dock workers' kitchen.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: I can write down the recipe for you, if you want.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Mm—

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: No need to be shy, it's the least we can do.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: If not for your help, we couldn't possibly have fixed all the damaged floats before the parade tonight.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I'm just thinkin' how authentic Siracusan pizza might go over with the Lungmenites. Maybe Exusiai could add it to the menu at The Ends of the Earth.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: What about that signore who's singing while working? Should I call him over?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey, Big Mouth, over here! This'll shut you up.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I don't know what's worse, the way you break into song anytime anywhere, that obnoxious singin' voice of yours, or the song itself...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I mean, what's that crap? You belt that out while clappin' together your building blocks in the jungle?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Can't find the energy to work without song.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Unlike you, who's just sitting there giving 'advice', I'm the one who has to put in the work and sweat!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You got a reason to do that, I don't.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: It was your float that got its ass burned off, wasn't it?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: It was bad enough that it didn't look cool at all, but how could they put me so close to that wolf?!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Well, all the other floats have their arms and legs stuck back in place. The only one left is the wolf that's just a pile of ash now.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: If you ask me, it makes more sense to spend the time making the other floats look cooler than rebuilding one float.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: There are so many floats, who would miss one wolf?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Fair 'nuff.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: N-No! You can't do that!

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: There are many legends of beasts in Siracusa, but the wolf is special.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: City Hall had already announced the number of floats and what they're based on. People will get anxious if one is missing.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: You know—

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Hey fatso, stop stuffing that pie in my mouth—

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Pineapple? On pizza? Now THAT is what I call radical.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Do all Siracusan cops have to learn to make pizza?

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Oh no, my papa has a pizzeria in another city, and I used to help out there.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: We're pretty well-known. When I was little, I dreamed about having branches all over Siracusa, even our own dedicated headquarters plate.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Maybe you've heard of our ad? 'Noemi Pizza—one more slice even when you're full!'

steps.name: Emperor & High Priest
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: We never had the money to start a second one.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Business was good, and no one dares to not pay for their food, but paying our protection fee takes up most of our profit.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: I came when I heard that the Nuova Volsinii Police Academy was recruiting. Maybe I'll be able to protect the shop once I become a cop.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: I know what you want to say. It sounds naive, doesn't it? Being a cop is much harder, and then there's all the trouble that's popped up these last couple of days.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Think of this another way.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Becomin' a cop means you can change your slogan—

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: 'Noemi Pizza—if it isn't good, you can lock ME up!'

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: You remind me of my Zumama. The young always have such simple goals and such strong motivation.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: This is all YOUR fault, fatso. I didn't even have time to tell Zumama I was coming here.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ain't many parties worth bringing us together, Big Mouth.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Besides, we got serious business to talk about after the party.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Anyway, I really appreciate it! We were at our wit's end when you guys offered to help.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: As for your compensation, I'll put in an application with City Hall as soon as the Carnevale is over.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: We got our compensation already.
Emperor puts another pizza slice in his mouth.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: We'll see this through to the end. This IS good pizza, after all.
High Priest puts another pizza in his mouth.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Gotta admit, it gives me a warm n' fuzzy feelin' to see that wolf burn to ashes.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: So you...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: But it don't compare to the anger I feel when a good party gets ruined.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: Oh, cruel fate!

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: All the other stalls are busy preparing to make a killing tonight. We're the only ones who have been given the death sentence.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: I don't care, you're eating all the losses.

steps.name: Obstinate Partner
steps.text: That's just not fair. I did what I did with good intentions! I was trying to minimize the losses when the rain hit the other day.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: By getting the beer cart instead of the food drying in the courtyard out in the open?

steps.name: Obstinate Partner
steps.text: Mistakes happen...

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: The beer cart is fully enclosed and equipped with a functioning thermostat. Who cares if it gets a little rain on it? But you had to push it back, and now you cost me the spot that took me so much effort to get!

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: No stall, no food. This ain't a Carnevale, it's my funeral!

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: I should have stuck to movies. Yes, I had to deal with the mafiosi who all fancy themselves filmmakers, but at least I got to make a living. I shouldn't have listened to your tall tales and come here—

steps.name: Obstinate Partner
steps.text: Y-You again!
Zzz... zzz...

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: You're still here? Did you fall asleep on the spot after that ice cream?

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: Father? Father!

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: —I really should take a photo of you right now!

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: So what's stopping you?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I'll pay if it looks good.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: You said photo, right?

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Today is the biggest day of Nuova Volsinii. Everyone will show up fully dressed.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Masks, costumes, and massive, mysterious floats. Definitely something I would want to take a few photos of, for the memories.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But I can't stop for something like that, not when the parade keeps rolling. Wouldn't it be great if there was a professional photographer who could do it in my stead?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Besides, it's better business than competing with everyone else selling beer and ice cream—and to tell you the truth, your ice cream isn't that competitive. Not sweet enough.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: You heard the Father, what are you still standing around for?

steps.name: Obstinate Partner
steps.text: H-huh, what's happening now?

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: Go and get the camera! And don't forget to buy a few more rolls of film!

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: Thank you. Can't have two furs in one tail. Looks like this guy and I just don't match.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Problems always float to the surface, and there are always ways to deal with them.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: I don't think there's a church in this town... where did you come from, Father?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Montelupe.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: The capital... did you come all this way for Carnevale?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: An old friend asked me to see what it's all about.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: It's been a long time since Siracusa has had something this big, after all.

steps.name: Forlorn Merchant
steps.text: Like Leithanien's Empresses' Celebration, which takes place every year and involves the entire country, and it just gets bigger every year...

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Yes, it's been a long time since Siracusa has had something this big.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I hope it doesn't rain. It would make it so much harder to keep the peace.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: What are you doing, Signora Venezia?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You're not using this cloth anymore, right? Picked it out of the discard pile. Just right for wiping my blade.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: I could get a piece of softer cotton cloth for you.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: No need for that.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: There will be festivities on every street tonight. There's no need for you to stay at Tailor de Montano.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I promised Vargo to solve your problem.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: You found Luchino and accompanied me to the Villa Venezia to bring him back. You've already helped so much. Thank you.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: There's no need to thank me, Umberto.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You saved Luchino yourself, by convincing Venezia Senior to not pursue the matter any further.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Is he still shutting himself in the room? I haven't seen him. Don't tell me he's ran away again.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: If he runs away, just let him. So much has happened over the past couple of days, and he's still young. He needs time to process things.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Perhaps I've been too strict.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Maybe he's just struggling with how to view you, his own grandfather, an old tailor, and once the terror of Siracusan dons.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Well, that's not important. What's important is how he views himself after he stood at death's door and learned about all these things in the past.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: And he needs to figure it out. I don't have that much time left.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Well, Signora Venezia, I bid you addio.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: You already know, don't you?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: The culprit who hurt your daughter.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: And why would you say that?

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Did you forget I was once a killer too, Signora Venezia?

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Your weapon is sharp. It needs no honing, and you are not in the habit of doing so.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: When a killer starts polishing their blade, they're either planning to put it away forever, or planning to put it in someone.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Fair point.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: More conjecture than proof at this point... but at least I have something. That's why I said you don't have to thank me.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: You came to Nuova Volsinii and stayed here at de Montano to learn about the truth—who planned the assassination, and hurt Signorina Lisa.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: This was your agreement with Vargo, but if you have learned the answer, there's no reason to continue it.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Besides, I don't have any troubles left to deal with.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: The game is not over yet. The Fangs are still in the city. I've crossed blades with them. They may be young, but they fight well.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: If I can find them, they can find you.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You're old and frail, Umberto. There can only be one end.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: It's an end that already looms large. There's nothing you can do.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Tonight, at least, I wish to be alone, and have a moment of quiet to myself.

steps.name: Port Worker
steps.text: Alright, we'll be going—

steps.name: Port Worker
steps.text: Hey, new face. Where's the old dispatcher?

steps.name: Dispatcher
steps.text: ...Shift changed half an hour ago. He's probably in rehearsal right now.

steps.name: Port Worker
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Dispatcher
steps.text: Didn't you know? He used to be a saxist at the Teatro di Milano. They recruited him for the parade.

steps.name: Dispatcher
steps.text: I see. He's keeping you in the dark so he can show off tomorrow when his face is in the newspapers!

steps.name: Port Worker
steps.text: Stronzo!

steps.name: Port Worker
steps.text: So you're on duty tonight?

steps.name: Dispatcher
steps.text: Yup, I'm the new guy. On the bright side, the harbor's gonna be rather quiet because of all the festivities.

steps.name: Dispatcher
steps.text: I'll turn the radio up and feel the festive spirit from here.

steps.name: Dispatcher
steps.text: I would go now if I were you... if you want to get a good place in the procession.

steps.name: Port Worker
steps.text: Alright, be seeing you.

steps.name: Dispatcher
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You almost let it slip.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: How about you do it, then?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hey, I don't got the acting experience. You're the one who's an extra in the mayor's promotional video.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: It ain't the same thing. I was just being myself in the promo, and we could always do another take. Screw up just now, and all of Antonio's plans would've been blown.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: This is an important night for you, for me, and for all of Venezia.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: Once this city is firmly under our control, Antonio will be as good as his word. He'll support you in... what's the wording? Restoring the glory of Sicilia?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I just hope I don't end up like Carle...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What about our musicista?

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: Playing his saxophone in hell. In that container over there. We'll deal with the body once the dust settles.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You got the dispatch station, then.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: Don't worry.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: Every vehicle that goes in and out of the port has to go through special checks. Venezia Trucking's trucks have been added to the list.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: The nomadic city's positioning system has been turned off, with the exception of a single encrypted channel. Other than the famiglia's landship, no vehicles will approach the city tonight.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: The rest of the boys are outside. Once the landship approaches the city and starts docking, everybody in Nuova Volsinii Port who ain't part of this is gonna disappear.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: What about Antonio?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You think the boss needs us to worry about him?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: A few hours left... enjoy the night, Nuova Volsinii. Enjoy the true Carnevale.
Bit trite for an opening speech, don't you think?
The voice came from above.
The White Wolf looks down at them from atop a crane, amusement on her face, surprise and shock on theirs. She frowns, like a listener who can no longer tolerate the performance.

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: Who are you? Have you been here all this time?

steps.name: 'Dispatcher'
steps.text: Do her in, Gambino!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Gotcha.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I thought you said it was trite. But you're clappin'.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You just gave me the first twist, didn't you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You know, I was kind of hoping you would try to—how did he put it? 'Do me in.'

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I wanted to, but I ain't about to do somethin' doomed to fail.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Fair enough. Where's your little friend?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Capone? Helpin' Venezia Junior with some other stuff.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Sicilians been busy, eh?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Whaddya want, Lappland?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: We've done enough for you. I can't—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Uh, I mean...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Venezia Junior has put everything the famiglia's built over the past year into this. At this point, even if you wanna sabotage it, there's not much I can do to help.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You still think you know me, Gambino. Why would I make things hard for an old, er, friend?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Just do the job that your boss told you to.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What he's trying to do doesn't conflict with what I'm trying to do. Maybe I'm even trying to help him?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's Carnevale, after all. The night when all the wonderful dreams we have about this city come true.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That's why you didn't even need to kill this guy on the ground—oops.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You really shouldn't be so eager to prove that you're a villain. No wonder Capone's racking up citizen points so much faster than you.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: *Sigh*

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What else do you want me to do?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I dropped something at the Villa Venezia. Bring it to me.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: A gift box.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You mean, the one that the little tailor was—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And get me a bunch of ribbons, balloons, spotlights, that kind of stuff. Hurry!
